verdict.rationale: LM Studio's Bionic agent accepts natural-language input, including real-time transcribed speech, to create and edit documents and run agentic tasks, and a hands-on user reports it 'works great' (comm-19). However, nothing shows that LM Studio itself (loading, downloading, configuring models, starting servers) can be driven by natural language; those operations are documented only through the GUI and structured `lms` CLI commands. Missing for 10: natural-language control of core product operations such as model management and server control, depth of documentation on Bionic's command scope, and broader independent corroboration.
